structured_output.summary: Math.floor now follows all five spec steps in order. ToNumber is called with `?`. Non-finite values and ±0 are returned as-is, and the (0,1) range returns +0. Integral values are returned unchanged. Otherwise the result is n.floor(), which is the greatest integral Number not greater than n. The code has no test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no invented values. The only remaining gate failures come from Math.ceil being unimplemented in another built-in, which is an honest not-implemented error.
